config.enabled.description: Master switch for the extension. Turning it off disables all commands.
config.showOnboarding.description: Show a short guide the first time the extension starts.
config.backupSettings.description: Back up your current settings before applying the recommended settings (first time only).
config.confirmMultiLineTerminalPaste.des: Show a confirmation dialog before pasting multiple lines into the terminal.
config.multiLinePreviewMaxLines.descript: Maximum number of preview lines shown when confirming a terminal paste.
config.language.description: Display language for messages. `auto` follows the editor's display language (English if it is not supported). Supported: `ja` / `en` / `zh-cn` / `zh-tw` / `ko` / `es` / `fr` (Japanese, English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean, Spanish, French).
config.features.settings.description: Feature on/off: commands to apply / restore the recommended settings.
config.features.copyPlainText.descriptio: Feature on/off: copy as plain text.
config.features.pastePlainText.descripti: Feature on/off: paste as plain text.
config.features.safePasteToTerminal.desc: Feature on/off: safe paste to terminal.
config.features.terminalImagePaste.descr: Feature on/off: save the clipboard image and insert its path into the active terminal (Windows only).
Folder (absolute path) where terminal-image-paste saves images. If empty, images are saved in `images` under the extension's globalStorage.
config.terminalImagePaste.fileNamePatter: File name pattern for saved images. `YYYY`/`MM`/`DD`/`HH`/`mm`/`ss` are replaced with the date and time. `.png` is added if there is no extension.
config.terminalImagePaste.appendTrailing: Add a space after the saved path inserted into the terminal (makes it easier to keep typing CLI arguments).
